[[Rachael Lillis]] ([[EP019]]-[[EP256]]) |java1=[[Ikue Otani]] |}} '''Misty's Goldeen''' (Japanese: '''カスミのトサキント''' ''Kasumi's Tosakinto'') was one of the three original {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} acquired by {{an|Misty}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]] prior to the start of the {{pkmn|animated series}}, and the first to be seen in her possession. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|OS}}==== =====Kanto===== [[File:Misty Goldeen debut.png|thumb|left|220px|Goldeen in its debut, splashing uselessly]] Goldeen was first used in ''[[EP002|Pokémon Emergency!]]'' to distract {{TRT}} while {{Ash}} rescued the Pokémon in the {{ci|Viridian}} [[Pokémon Center]]. Since Goldeen was a {{t|Water}} Pokémon that couldn't battle on land, it uselessly flopped on the ground until {{an|Misty}} recalled it seconds later. Goldeen has proved helpful when Misty and her friends need assistance swimming or locating something underwater. In ''[[EP016|Pokémon Shipwreck]]'', Goldeen tried to find an exit out of the sunken [[S.S. Anne|St. Anne]]. Instead, it discovered Team Rocket, who would otherwise have drowned, and brought them to the surface. Later, Goldeen towed Misty to the surface, while {{TP|Misty|Starmie}} and {{AP|Squirtle}} followed behind with {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}}. It was later sent out to attempt to drag the raft away from [[James's Gyarados]], but they were all caught up in the {{m|Dragon Rage}} and sent flying. It reappeared in ''[[EP019|Tentacool & Tentacruel]]'', where it helped {{TP|Misty|Staryu}} and Starmie rescue sailors who had been attacked by {{p|Tentacool}}, later pushing back against an invasion of the {{t|Water}}/{{t|Poison}} Pokémon on [[Porta Vista]]. =====Orange Islands===== Misty continued using Goldeen very sparingly at the [[Orange Islands]] because it could not battle or maneuver outside of water. It often did poorly when it was called out due to its lack of battle [[experience]]. An example of this is a battle against {{OBP|Marina|EP091}} in ''[[EP091|Bye Bye Psyduck]]'', where it lost to her {{p|Tentacruel}}, before [[Misty's Staryu]] took over and won. [[File:Misty Goldeen vs Dorian Qwilfish.png|thumb|220px|Goldeen battling against Dorian's Qwilfish]] In ''[[EP094|Snack Attack]]'', Goldeen was sent out in an attempt to fight a wild {{AP|Snorlax}}, but it was completely helpless and was almost eaten before being recalled. In ''[[EP110|The Stun Spore Detour]]'', Goldeen defeated [[James's Victreebel]] with ease thanks to Fury Attack, despite the type disadvantage. Its ability to use Water Gun was revealed in ''[[EP113|Viva Las Lapras]]'', where it joined [[Misty's Staryu]], [[Misty's Politoed|Poliwag]], and [[Ash's Squirtle]] in attacking [[Captain Crook]]'s poacher ship. ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== In ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]'', Goldeen was called up against [[Molly Hale]]. Being underwater, Goldeen was able to fight to its full potential. Despite this, it was no match for Molly's {{p|Kingdra}}, who knocked it out with a single {{m|Headbutt}}. In ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]'', Goldeen was sent out alongside Misty and Brock's Pokémon to stop {{an|Giovanni}} and the rest of [[Team Rocket]] from recapturing {{OBP|Mewtwo|M01}}. Their distraction gave Ash the time he needed to take Mewtwo to the top of [[Mount Quena]] so it could be healed. In its continued infrequent usage, Goldeen fought [[Dorian]]'s {{p|Qwilfish}} in ''[[EP256|Just Add Water]]'', managing to land a {{m|Horn Attack}} after dodging Qwilfish's Tackles with Agility. Goldeen then used {{m|Supersonic}}, but Qwilfish shrugged off its effects and fired {{m|Pin Missile}}. Goldeen managed to reflect those coming its way by spinning its tail. Goldeen aimed a {{m|Horn Drill}}, which Qwilfish dodged. Qwilfish used another Pin Missile, hammering Goldeen from behind. A final {{m|Take Down}} was enough to knock Goldeen out and win the round for Dorian. ====[[Pokémon Chronicles]]==== In ''[[HS16|Luvdisc is a Many Splendored Thing!]]'', Goldeen performed as a part of {{an|Daisy}}'s water ballet. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Misty and Goldeen.png|thumb|left|220px|Goldeen and Misty]] Goldeen is shown to be quite strong and fast, often being called upon to transport {{an|Misty}} or others in the water. In a true testament to its strength, Goldeen rescued the [[Team Rocket trio]] when they were trapped and drowning aboard the capsized [[S.S. Anne|St. Anne]] during ''[[EP016|Pokémon Shipwreck]]''. Goldeen wasn't seen very often due to it being a water-bound species, flailing when displaced from it. However, in water, Goldeen's potential shone through. Goldeen was shown to know a variety of techniques that helped it defeat other Pokémon, such as {{TP|James|Victreebel}} in ''[[EP110|The Stun Spore Detour]]''. Its incredible {{m|Agility}} and deadly {{m|Horn Attack}} were amongst its best techniques, though it was overwhelmingly a physical attacker. Goldeen faced difficulties against other {{type|Water}} specialists like {{OBP|Marina|EP091}} in ''[[EP091|Bye Bye Psyduck]]'' and [[Dorian]] in ''[[EP256|Just Add Water]]''. {{-}} ===Moves used=== In addition to the 60 main cards, the deck includes four expansion cards, a coin, rulebook, and Pokémon Gym Guide. ==Trivia== * Despite debuting in ''[[EP002|Pokémon Emergency]]'', Goldeen did not actually use an attack until ''[[EP091|Bye Bye Psyduck]]'', 89 episodes later. * Despite being infamous for being all but useless on land, in ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]'', Goldeen is seen being able to hop around on land to move. * Goldeen's only onscreen victory was in ''[[EP110|The Stun Spore Detour]]'' against [[James's Victreebel]]. * Goldeen is the first Pokémon belonging to a main character to use a [[multistrike move]]. * Despite Goldeen being in Misty's possession throughout the entire Johto arc of the [[original series]], which consisted of 156 episodes, it physically appeared in only 12 episodes during that time. ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Goldeen}} {{Misty's Pokémon|water}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Misty's Pokémon|Goldeen]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Pokémon Zensho characters]] [[Category:Ash & Pikachu characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Newspaper Strip characters]] [[de:Mistys Goldini]] [[es:Goldeen de Misty]] [[fr:Poissirène d'Ondine]] [[it:Goldeen di Misty]] [[ja:カスミのトサキント]] [[zh:小霞的角金鱼]]
